column1: # ZAP baseline rules for .github/workflows/zap.yml (M9-05).
# One line per rule: <plugin id> TAB <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL> TAB <why>.
# A rule not listed here fails the scan when it raises an alert. Lower a rule
# only for a finding that has been read and accepted, and say why on its line;
# docs/guides/security-scanning.md has the procedure.
# 10049 Storable and cacheable content: the admin's hashed assets are meant to
# be cached; every api response sets its own Cache-Control.

column3: (Non-Storable / Storable and Cacheable Content: hashed static assets)

column1: # 10104 User agent fuzzer: informational by design.
# 2 sees the documentation fixture address in the mock API bundled for local
# development. It is not an address of this deployment.

column3: (Private IP Disclosure: documented mock SSRF-refusal address)

column1: # The minified application contains example prose and URLs whose adjacent
# tokens resemble comments about databases, users and queries.

column3: (Suspicious Comments: minified fixture text, not source comments or secrets)

column1: # The font asset name and the mock API's one-pixel data URL are public assets.

column3: (Base64 Disclosure: font path and public one-pixel mock image)

column1: # APCA colour conversion constants happen to be valid Unix timestamp integers.
# The admin is intentionally a client-routed React application.
# Only the en/ar locale and light/dark preference live in localStorage.
# COEP would reject configured cross-origin object-storage media. The app uses
# no SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin-isolation feature that requires it.

column3: (COEP absent: cross-origin media is required and isolation is not)

column1: # ZAP's direct HTTP requests are not browser navigations, so no Sec-Fetch-*
# request headers exist for the passive rule to observe.

column3: (Sec-Fetch request headers: scanner is not a browser)
